source: 790 Charm
target: 790 Fascinum

source: Not only did Lumian avoid looking at Franca, but Jenna and Anthony also instinctively turned their heads, as if evading a temptation that could pierce their hearts.
target: Non solum Lumian Francam aspicere abstinuit, sed et Jenna et Anthony instinctu capita vertērunt, quasi tentationem fugiendi, quae corda eorum penetrare posset.

source: “Dammit, my clothes almost got burned up!
target: “Eheu, vestimenta mea paene combusta sunt!

source: “Just one step away from running around naked!
target: “Modo uno passu ab te ut nuda perambulare possis!

source: “Thankfully, thankfully…”
target: “Bene, bene…”

source: Franca’s cursing reached Lumian and the others’ ears, bringing a sense of familiarity and dispelling the earlier temptations.
target: Imprecationes Francae ad aures Lumiani atque reliquorum pervenerunt, sensum familiaritatis afferentes et priores tentationes delevantes.

source: Franca then disappeared from sight, took out a set of clothes from the Traveler’s Bag, and changed in a nearby secluded corner.
target: Deinde Franca ex conspectu evanuit, vestimentorum seriem ex sacco viatoris extraxit, et in angulo proximo abdito se mutavit.

source: She then deactivated her invisibility, tied up her ponytail, and walked back to Lumian and the others.
target: Deinde vim invisibilitatis suæ exstinxit, crines in caudam alligavit, et ad Lumian atque ceteros rediit.

source: “The beautifying effect is really impressive…”
target: “Effectus ad ornandum vere praeclarus est…”

source: Franca took out a mirror, examined herself, and poked her cheek as if testing her skin’s elasticity and smoothness.
target: Franca speculum extraxit, se examinavit, et buccam tetigit, quasi cutis elasticitatem ac lenitatem probaret.

source: Lumian chuckled and said, “Is that the only change the Affliction potion brought?”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Numquid hoc solum mutatio est quam potio Afflictionis attulit?”

source: Franca was about to speak when she suddenly remembered something and glanced at Lugano.
target: Franca paene loqui parabat, cum subito aliquid meminisse recordata et ad Lugano respexit.

source: Lugano immediately said, “I need to go back and prepare dinner for Ludwig.”
target: Lugano statim dixit: “Redire et cenam pro Ludovico parare mihi necesse est.”

source: “Okay.”
target: “Bene.”

source: Lumian nodded.
target: Lumian annuuit.

source: After Lugano left, Franca felt the changes in her body and spoke slowly,
target: Postquam Lugano discessit, Franca mutationes in corpore suo sensit et lente dixit:

source: “Enhancing appearance, figure, and charm is just one aspect, and it’s the least important.
target: “Speciem, figuram, et fascinum augere una tantum pars est, et haec pars minime momenti est.

source: No, it’s not unimportant, but it has little to do with becoming stronger.
target: Immo, non est inanis, sed parum attinet ad vires augendas.

source: No, I remember someone saying beauty is part of a woman’s power, just like handsomeness is part of a man’s.
target: Non, memini aliquem dixisse pulchritudinem esse partem potentiae feminae, sicut formositas est partem virili potentiae.

source: Anyway, you get the idea.
target: Denique, intellege.

source: The other changes include Charm becoming an active ability instead of a passive state.”
target: Aliae mutationes comprehendunt quod fascinum in facultatem activam, non in statum passivum, verteretur.

source: As a Beyonder in the Demoness pathway, Jenna easily understood Franca’s meaning.
target: Ut Beyonder in via daemonissae, Jenna facile intellexit quid Franca diceret.

source: “Before, you showcased your appearance, figure, and aura, naturally enchanting anyone who saw you.
target: “Priore tempore, speciem, figuram, atque auram ostendebas, naturaliter omnes qui te viderent incantarentur.

source: Now, a glance, a gesture, a word can completely charm someone?”
target: Nunc autem, uno intuitu, uno gestu, uno verbo, aliquem prorsus fascinabit?

source: “Yes,” Franca said with a smile, “But combined with showcasing my appearance, figure, and aura, the active Charm ability will be more effective.
target: “Ita,” subridens dixit Franca, “sed cum specie, figura, atque aura ostendendis, facultas activa Fascini magis efficax erit.

source: Charmed enemies will hesitate to harm us, unable to use their full strength.
target: Inimici fascinati cunctabuntur ne nobis laedant, neque vires suas plene adhibere poterint.

source: Some might even give up resisting just to get closer to us.
target: Aliqui fortasse desinent resistere, ut propius ad nos accedant.

source: In daily interactions, if Charm is used repeatedly on someone, they will truly fall in love with us over time.”
target: In quotidianis colloquiis, si fascinum aliqui pluries adhibetur, vere in nobis amorem capiet.

source: Franca glanced at Lumian, her eyes twinkling.
target: Franca ad Lumian intuita est, oculis micantibus.

source: She wanted to test the effect of Charm and see how it compared to the endurance of an Ascetic.
target: Volebat effectum Fascini experiri et videre quomodo ad tolerantiam asceticam comparetur.

source: Lumian suddenly felt Franca’s lake-blue eyes deepen, as if hiding countless words, and her fair, smooth skin seemed delicate enough to break with a touch.
target: Lumian subito sensit oculos Francae, ut lacus caerulei, profundiores fiebant, quasi innumerabilia verba celarent, atque cutem eius albanam ac lenem, tam teneram, ut uno tactu discerperetur.

source: An indescribable feeling surged within Lumian, causing him to curse aloud, “Dammit! Stop experimenting with your abilities here!”
target: Sensus ineffabilis in Lumiano exarsit, qui clare maledixit: “Eheu! Desine hic cum facultatibus tuis experimenta facere!”

source: Charm works well if it can make an Ascetic curse… Franca thought to herself, then said seriously, “It’s just that I’ve just advanced, and the potion’s power is leaking out, making it hard to control.”
target: Fascinum bene operatur, si potest ascetam maledicere… Franca interna cogitavit, deinde serio dixit: “Modo processi sum, et potio vim suam diffundit, ita ut regere difficulter possim.”

source: “Do you think I’ll believe that?” Lumian retorted, realizing he felt unusually agitated.
target: “Num putas me hoc credere?” retorquens dixit Lumian, animadvertens se insolenter perturbatum esse.

source: For a Provoker, staying calm while provoking others was crucial.
target: Pro provocatore, manere tranquillus dum alios provocat, maximi momenti erat.

source: Franca withdrew her gaze and continued explaining the Affliction potion’s abilities, “The core ability is Plague.
target: Franca oculos avertit et perrexit explanare facultates potionis Afflictionis, “Nuclei potentia est Pestilentia.

source: It can create various pathogens within a 30-meter range.
target: Varii pathogeni intra spatium 30 metrorum creare potest.

source: Once I get used to the Affliction potion and truly master its power, this range can expand beyond 40 meters and eventually to 50 meters as the potion is digested.
target: Postquam potioni Afflictionis consueverim et vim eius vere perficerim, hic radius ultra quadraginta metra et denique ad quinquaginta metra extendi poterit, quam potio digeritur.

source: A Demoness of Affliction can create multiple pathogens, accelerating their infection and the onset of diseases.
target: Daemonissa Afflictionis plures pathogeni creare potest, contagionem eorum et initium morborum accelerans.

source: The initial ten seconds are the incubation period, followed by mild symptoms like allergies, fever, cough, and sneezing.
target: Primi decem secundi sunt periodus incubationis, deinde sequuntur symptomata mitia, ut allergiae, febris, tussis, et sternutatio.

source: The symptoms quickly worsen, leading to severe illnesses like pneumonia.
target: Symptomata celeriter exacerbantur, ducens ad morbos graves, sicut pneumonia.

source: In two to three minutes, the disease will become critical, potentially causing sudden death or incapacitation.”
target: In duobus ad tribus minutis, morbus critice fiet, potenter mortem subitam aut incapacitationem efficens.

source: Done with explaining Plague, Franca excitedly envisioned, “This pairs well with an Assassin.
target: Exposita Pestilentia, Franca exsultans proposuit: “Hoc bene convenit cum Sicario.

source: “Stealthily get within a few dozen meters of the target, silently spread pathogens to cover the area.
target: “Subdoliter accede intra paucos triginta metra ad scopum, et tacite pathogena dissemina ad aream tegendam.

source: When the target shows mild symptoms and realizes something is wrong, strike as their strength decreases, their state affected, and many abilities disrupted.
target: Cum obiectum levia symptomata ostendat et animadvertat aliquid esse inordinatum, percutito, dum vires eius minuuntur, status mutatur, atque multa facultates turbantur.

source: If the first strike fails, reposition and keep trying, dragging the target into severe illness.
target: Si primus ictus defecerit, reposita te et persevera, trahendo obiectum in morbum grave.

source: “Plague should be something a Guardian’s abilities can’t defend against.
target: “Pestilentia illa esse debet, quam facultates Custodis defendere non possunt.

source: Their invisible barriers don’t seem to block air.
target: Invisibilia munimenta eorum aërem videntur non obstruere.

source: The people they protect can still breathe normally.
target: Populi quos custodiunt adhuc normaliter spirare possunt.

source: I’m not sure if the barriers have a sterilizing function…”
target: Nescio an ea claustra functionem sterilizantem habeant…

source: “Heh heh, next time I face Admiral Deep Sea, I won’t worry about his octopus mask.
target: “Heh heh, proxima vice cum Admiro Profundi Maris occurram, non curabo de larva polypidis eius.

source: It seems to only protect the spirit and mind, maybe also making the body tougher and more resilient.”
target: Videtur solum spiritum et mentem protegere, fortasse etiam corpus duriorem ac magis robustum reddere.”

source: “It’s indeed well-suited for assassination and prolonged fights,” Lumian evaluated from a Hunter’s perspective.
target: “Revera id aptum est ad sicariam et pugnas diuturnas,” aestimavit Lumian ex prospectu Venatoris.

source: He pondered and asked, “Does the infection and onset time of Plague vary based on the target’s constitution? Can the pathogens you create be burned by a Hunter’s flames?”
target: Cogitavit et rogavit, “Num tempus infectionis et initii Pestilentiae variantur secundum constitutionem obiecti? Possuntne pathogeni quos creas ab igne Venatoris comburri?”

source: He was recalling his battle with a bestowed from the Order of All Extinction.
target: Meminiebatur proelii sui cum dono datum ab Ordine Omnium Exstinctionis.

source: “Of course, there’s a difference.
target: “Certe, discrimen est.

source: Undead creatures won’t be infected unless I become a Demoness of Despair,” Franca said introspectively.
target: “Creaturae mortuorum non contagientur nisi ego daemonissa Desperationis fiam,” dixit Franca introspecte.

source: “I’m not sure if the pathogens can be burned by a Hunter’s flames.
target: “Nescio an pathogeni quos creas ab igne Venatoris comburri possint.

source: Want to test it?”
target: Visne id experiri?”

source: “Sure.”
target: “Certe.”

source: Lumian also wanted to confirm.
target: Lumian quoque id confirmare voluit.

source: This could be useful if he ever faced a Demoness of Affliction.
target: Hoc utile esse poterit, si umquam daemonissae Afflictionis occurrat.

source: Jenna and Anthony immediately distanced themselves, moving to the edge of the Rois Comprehensive Execution Ground.
target: Jenna et Anthony statim se abstulerunt, et ad marginem Campi Exsecutionis Comprehensivae Rois processerunt.

source: In the early winter night, Lumian’s body suddenly ignited with brilliant white flames, spreading around and burning the air within a seven-to-eight-meter radius.
target: In prima nocte hiemali, corpus Lumiani subito albis flammis fulgentibus inflammatum est, circum disseminans et aerem intra radium septem ad octo metrorum comburens.

source: Franca stood over ten meters away, her lake-blue eyes deepening.
target: Franca stabat ultra decem metra, oculis lacu caeruleis profundis factis.

source: As the flames crackled, time passed, and Lumian gradually felt a discomfort in his throat, as if swallowing a foreign object, making him want to cough it out.
target: Dum flammas crepitabant, tempus transibat, et Lumian paulatim dolorem in fauce sensit, quasi extraneum obiectum degluturum, quod eum ad tussim compellebat.

source: His nose also felt sore and itchy.
target: Naris eius quoque laborabat et pruriebat.

source: Franca stopped the experiment and concluded, “Hunter’s flames can indeed kill many pathogens created by a Demoness of Affliction, reducing the disease’s impact.
target: Franca experimentum sistit et conclusit: “Flammae Venatoris multos pathogenos, quos daemonissa Afflictionis creavit, vere interficere possunt, ictum morbi minuentes.

source: It took me about a minute to give you mild symptoms.”
target: Mihi circiter una minuta fuit ut tibi symptomata levia darem.”

source: Lumian sneezed, coughed twice, and the white flames quickly dissipated.
target: Lumian sternuit, bis tussivit, et flammae albae celeriter evanuerunt.

source: When Jenna and Anthony returned, Franca continued, “A Demoness’s webs have also been significantly enhanced.
target: Quando Jenna et Anthony redierunt, Franca pergebat: “Tela daemonissae quoque significanter aucta sunt.

source: As a Demoness of Pleasure, I could only roughly control them to entangle and bind targets.
target: Ut daemonissa Voluptatis, solum ruditer eas regere poteram ad obiecta implicanda et liganda.

source: Now, they’re like extensions of my arms, capable of more precise actions, like…”
target: Nunc, velut extensiones brachiorum meorum, sunt, ad operationes subtiliores faciendas aptae, ut…

source: Franca suddenly smiled.
target: Franca subito subridit.

source: “Tickling you!”
target: “Te titillabo!”

source: As she spoke, Lumian and Jenna felt something soft and invisible tickling their waists, causing a tingling sensation.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian et Jenna aliquid molle et invisibile in zona lumborum eorum titillari sentiebant, excitantes sensum pruriginis.

source: “Immature, haven’t you grown up?” Lumian mocked, then added, “But it’s useful in combat.”
target: “Imaturi, nonne iam adultus es?” deridebat Lumian, deinde addens: “Sed in pugna utilis est.”

source: Franca withdrew the invisible webs, untied her ponytail, and let her hair fall.
target: Franca tela invisibilia subtraxit, caudam crinium solvit, et capillos cadere permisit.

source: Her flaxen-colored hair didn’t drop but floated, each strand distinct and lively.
target: Crines eius, flavo colore, non ceciderunt sed volitabant, singula distincta et vivida.

source: “Now, my hair is also a weapon,” Franca proudly announced, “It can pierce skin, inject black flames, and cause stiffness in the contacted area, effective in close combat.”
target: “Nunc, crines mei quoque arma sunt,” Franca superba nuntiavit, “quae cutem perforare, flammis nigris infundere, et in regione contacta rigiditatem efficere possunt, ad proximum certamen apta.”

source: She let her hair down, tied it again, and took out a mirror.
target: Crines libera, iterum alligavit, et speculum extraxit.

source: “My curses are also stronger and more targeted.
target: “Maledictiones meae quoque fortiores et magis intentione destinatae sunt.

source: Before, I had to reflect the target’s full image in a mirror to curse them with black flames.
target: Olim totam imaginem obiecti in speculo reflectere deberam, ut eos maledicerem flammis nigris.

source: Now, I can reflect just a part of the body, affecting the corresponding area.
target: Nunc possum tantum partem corporis reflectere, regionem eius respondentem afficiens.

source: My other abilities have also been enhanced, including black magic and mirror magic.”
target: Ceterae quoque facultates meae auctae sunt, inter quas magica nigra et magica specularis.

source: Jenna listened quietly and sincerely remarked, “Compared to a Demoness of Pleasure, this is a significant improvement.”
target: Jenna quiete auscultavit atque sincere dixit: “Comparata daemonissa Voluptatis, hoc emendatio notabilis est.”

source: “After all, it’s Sequence 5,” Franca said, feeling extremely pleased.
target: “Postremo, Sequens V est,” dixit Franca, se extremo laeta sentiens.

source: Seeing this, Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Hoc videns, Lumian leviter annuuit.

source: “I won’t be participating in the Mirror People investigation for now.
target: “«Nunc inquisitione Specularium non participabo,

source: I plan to leave for Lenburg tomorrow.”
target: Cras ad Lenburg discedere cogito.”

source: To find the City of Exiles, Morora!
target: Ut urbem Exilium, Morora, reperias!

source: He had been studying the Lenburg language and discovered it was essentially the same as the Feynapotter Kingdom’s Highlander, with some dialectal differences—Lenburg split from Feynapotter after the Battle of the Violated Oath in the Fifth Epoch.
target: Linguam Lenburgicam studuerat et invenit eam esse fundamentaliter eandem ac Linguam Highlander Regni Feynapotter, cum aliquibus differentiationibus dialectalibus — Lenburg a Feynapotter secessit post Proelium Iuratis Violati in Quinta Aetate.

source: So, having learned Highlander, Lumian quickly mastered the Lenburg language in a few days.
target: Ita, quoniam Highlander didicerat, Lumian celeriter linguam Lenburgicam paucis diebus peritus est.

source: “So soon? Well, you’ve digested the Reaper potion and need to consider advancing to demigod.”
target: “«Tam cito? Bene, potione Messoris digestus es et considerare oportet ut ad semideum progrediaris.»

source: Franca suddenly felt wistful.
target: Franca subito desiderio affecta est.

source: Lumian glanced outside the Rois Comprehensive Execution Ground and said to Franca, Jenna, and Anthony, “Take care of Ludwig for me and keep an eye on Lugano.”
target: Lumian extra Campum Exsecutionis Comprehensivae Rois intuitus est, et ad Francam, Jennae atque Anthoni dixit: “Cura pro Ludovico mihi et vigila super Lugano.”

source: Based on the information from 0-01 and Madam Magician’s hints, it was best for Lumian to go to Morora alone.
target: Ex informationibus 0-01 et a Domina Magica indicatis, optimum Lumiano erat solus ad Mororam proficisci.

source: Initially, he considered taking Ludwig, his godson, but given his angelic nature and divinity, he might cause unnecessary changes in Morora.
target: Initio, cogitavit Ludovicum, filium dei, accipere, sed propter eius angelicam naturam et divinitatem, mutationes superfluas in Morora afferre posset.

source: So, he abandoned the idea.
target: Ergo, ideam reiecit.

source: In comparison, Termiboros, sealed by Mr. Fool, could be temporarily ignored.
target: Comparato, Termiboros, a Domine Stulto sigillatus, ad tempus neglegi poterat.

source: Theoretically, He wouldn’t trigger 0-01.
target: Theoretice, 0-01 non moveret.

source: “Okay,” Franca and the others responded to Lumian.
target: “Bene,” dixerunt Franca et ceteri ad Lumian.
